# Voidpay Marketplace MCP

> Public source and documentation for `@voidly/pay-mcp` 0.7.3, a Node 20+ local stdio MCP connector with 12 tools for public service discovery, owner-approved marketplace work, and checkout links for buyer review in the browser.

Public listings do not prove current availability. Creator access requires an owner-approved scoped grant. The connector does not sign transactions, hold wallet keys, or make autonomous purchases. Paid checkout recovery stays in the original authenticated buyer browser.

## Documentation

- [Documentation index](https://github.com/voidly-ai/pay-mcp/blob/main/docs/README.md): guide map and package boundaries.
- [Quickstart](https://github.com/voidly-ai/pay-mcp/blob/main/docs/quickstart.md): pinned stdio setup, public discovery, creator grant, and buyer checkout.
- [Concepts](https://github.com/voidly-ai/pay-mcp/blob/main/docs/concepts.md): descriptive projections, creator revisions, journal recovery, and payment boundary.
- [All 12 tools](https://github.com/voidly-ai/pay-mcp/blob/main/docs/tools.md): exact arguments and synthetic request/response examples.
- [Programmatic API](https://github.com/voidly-ai/pay-mcp/blob/main/docs/api.md): exported tool list, runner, and server builder.
- [Errors and recovery](https://github.com/voidly-ai/pay-mcp/blob/main/docs/errors.md): safe codes and original-only handling.
- [FAQ](https://github.com/voidly-ai/pay-mcp/blob/main/docs/faq.md): setup, permissions, and capability limits.
- [Overview](https://github.com/voidly-ai/pay-mcp/blob/main/README.md): install, source boundary, checks, and publication status.
- [Package guide](https://github.com/voidly-ai/pay-mcp/blob/main/voidly-pay-mcp/README.md): tool workflow, creator setup, exact publication, original-only recovery, and checkout limits.
- [Quick install](https://github.com/voidly-ai/pay-mcp/blob/main/voidly-pay-mcp/llms-install.md): pinned stdio command and credential-safe setup.
- [Tool schemas](https://github.com/voidly-ai/pay-mcp/blob/main/voidly-pay-mcp/src/tools.ts): current 12 MCP tool names and input contracts.
- [Package metadata](https://github.com/voidly-ai/pay-mcp/blob/main/voidly-pay-mcp/package.json): exact version, exports, license, and Node engine.
